title: Manager - Tax Data Analytics Engineer
Risk and Controls Operations Associate
description:
Risk and Controls Operations Associate

Office Location: Temple, London - hybrid working environment (3 days in office per week)

Reporting: Chief Operating Officer

About Investa

Investa is building the UK’s first zero-commission Options and Stocks trading platform. Legacy platforms typically feature high fees and complex interfaces that cut out the majority of retail investors. We are building a streamlined alternative to fix that.

So far, we have raised £3.5 million in funding, secured direct regulatory approval from the FCA, and picked up two major awards in 2026: Best Options Trading App (Good Money Guide) and Best App for Options Trading (ADVFN). Having launched on iOS - reaching 4,000+ total sign-ups - we have now just launched on Android, doubling our addressable market as we scale toward targets of 10,000 users, 100,000, and beyond.

Key Platform Traction:

  • 8,000+ trades processed

  • 2,500+ early supporters rewarded for their loyalty

  • 1,000+ shareholders backing our vision

  • 150+ 5-star reviews

Our goal is straightforward: Think Options, Think Investa.

We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative.

The Role

As our Risk & Controls Operations Associate, you will serve as the first line of regulatory and operational control for Investa’s platform. Working together with our Head of Risk & Compliance and Co-Founders, you will help own the day-to-day execution of our key operational controls spanning CASS oversight, onboarding operations, financial crime monitoring, and execution control.

This is a critical, high-visibility role within a fast-scaling financial trading environment. You will bridge regulatory oversight with practical execution: verifying client money flows, resolving dealing and onboarding exceptions, and ensuring our operations adhere strictly to FCA standards as our operating model expands from sub-account clearing into in-house custody.

What the role involves

1. Risk & Control Operations

  • CASS Reconciliations: Perform daily internal & external CASS reconciliations across Investa’s client base to prevent breaches and ensure compliance with day-to-day CASS obligations.

  • CASS Reporting & Audits: Maintain audit-ready compliance records, log breaks and CASS breaches, and assist in preparing regulatory returns and notifications when needed.

  • KYC & Onboarding Operations: Own the day-to-day onboarding queue, performing KYC/AML document reviews, appropriateness assessments, and managing PEPs, sanctions, and high-risk escalations.

  • Financial Crime Monitoring: Organise high-risk client reviews assisting with enhanced due diligence, source of funds/wealth checks, and periodic and event driven reviews.

  • Vulnerable Customer Framework: Manage sensitive customer cases as identified in the vulnerable clients policy, ensure good outcomes for clients with support needs, manage key performance indicators for clients in this segment in strict compliance with Consumer Duty standards and internal policies.

2. Business Oversight & Governance Support

  • Management Information: Own and gather key performance indicators covering all aspects of the business for committee reporting and oversight.

  • Financial Promotions: Review and approve marketing campaigns, product copy, and social media promotions to ensure strict alignment with FCA Financial Promotion and Consumer Duty rules.

  • Regulatory Change: Assist in implementation of regulatory change in the UK or elsewhere to ensure compliance with new rules that apply to the Firm.

  • Third Party Risk Management: Point of contact for vendors and outsourcing partners to oversee and coordinate information sharing for incident closure & customer support.

  • Trade surveillance: Provide first line review of alerts generated through trade surveillance for signs of market abuse. Oversee the closure of alerts and applicable audit trail.

Your Background

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience covering trade operations or controls support at a regulated firm, FinTech, investment platform, or broker.

  • Understanding of the regulatory framework surrounding CASS, Consumer Duty, Systems & Controls, and Anti-Money Laundering.

  • Direct experience executing CASS reconciliation workflows, client adoption, and trade surveillance.

  • Strong analytical mindset with high attention to detail and sound, practical judgement.

  • Technical proficiency in Office and Google-based software including excel, Google Sheets, Google Docs.

Desirable

  • Prior exposure to retail investment platforms, derivatives markets.

  • Experience using workflow tools like Jira or case management software.

  • Familiarity with third-party clearing integrations (e.g., Interactive Brokers) or regulatory reporting tools.

  • CISI or equivalent qualification regarding financial services, client assets, or regulatory modules.

  • Understanding of EU regulation.

What we offer

  • Career Ownership & Impact: You have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career.

  • Collaboration & Proximity: You work alongside our co-founders. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a voice in the product journey.

  • Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.

  • Shared Success & Equity: We are in this together. To ensure everyone benefits from our growth, every employee receives meaningful company equity. Our success is your success.

 

Compensation and Benefits

Financial Growth 💸

  • Competitive base salary - depending on experience.

  • Equity: Initial grant of 0.1% - 0.15% in stock options. We reward impact with additional performance-based grants and milestone-linked top-ups.

  • Annual Review: Structured salary and performance reviews conducted every year to ensure your growth stays on track.

Health & Wellbeing 🌴🦷

  • Annual Leave: 30 days (including bank holidays) + your birthday off.

  • Premium Coverage: Private medical and dental insurance via Bupa.

Office Environment & Lifestyle ☕

  • The Office: Work from a vibrant, spacious office featuring a private gym and a rooftop terrace for fresh-air breaks.

  • Fuel & Socials: Enjoy tea, coffee and snacks daily. Every last Wednesday of the month, we host a Team Lunch where the menu is chosen by the staff. We also run regular team socials, alongside company and individual milestone celebrations.

Tech 💻

  • Custom Setup: You’ll receive a high-spec MacBook and £150 toward a mouse and keyboard of your choice.

Interview Process

  • Stage 1: Screening with Talent Lead

  • Stage 2: HM Intro with our COO

  • Stage 3: Interview with our Head of Risk & Compliance

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Junior Digital Assets Operations Analyst
description:
Application URL
https://omegadg.com/work/remoteok

Omega Enterprises is an international digital-assets company focused on cryptocurrency markets, market intelligence, and data-based financial operations. We are expanding our team and looking for motivated people who would like to build practical knowledge of digital markets and develop their analytical skills.

This is an entry-level opportunity designed for candidates who are interested in cryptocurrency, financial markets, and working with market information. Previous employment in the crypto industry is not necessary. New team members receive onboarding, training, and ongoing support from experienced colleagues.

What You'll Do

  • Follow daily developments across cryptocurrency and digital-asset markets.
  • Assist the team with routine operational and analytical activities.
  • Track changes in prices, trading activity, liquidity, and other relevant indicators.
  • Gather information from internal and external market-data sources.
  • Maintain organized records and prepare concise internal reports.
  • Summarize market observations for team discussions.
  • Take part in regular training, feedback sessions, and team meetings.
  • Complete structured tasks under the guidance of more experienced team members.

What You'll Get

  • Fully remote working arrangement.
  • Flexible day-to-day workflow.
  • Structured onboarding for people new to the crypto industry.
  • Training in basic market-analysis and digital-asset tools.
  • Access to practical market information and analytical resources.
  • Regular feedback and guidance from a mentor.
  • A clear path for developing toward more advanced analytical responsibilities.
  • Opportunity to work within an international digital-assets team.

The Person We're Looking For

  • Are genuinely interested in cryptocurrency, financial markets, or market analytics.
  • Enjoy learning new tools and working with structured information.
  • Pay attention to detail when handling data and written tasks.
  • Can follow procedures and instructions consistently.
  • Are dependable, organized, and comfortable working independently.
  • Have English proficiency around B2 or higher, sufficient for professional tools, market information, and training materials.

Position Details

  • Position: Junior Digital Assets Operations Analyst
  • Work format: Remote
  • Experience: Entry level / training provided
